label: Bible Study
prompt: Thy word is a _____ unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
note: A lamp for the feet: enough light for the next step, not the whole road.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto _____, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
verse: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
note: Joseph's whole biography in one line: men meant evil, God meant it unto good.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he dreamed, and behold a _____ set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
verse: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
note: Jacob dreamed of a ladder, not a stairway — the song came much later than the KJV.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the _____ of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
verse: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
note: God isn't scanning for perfect people, but for hearts perfect toward him — Asa learned this the hard way.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the _____ of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
verse: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
note: The heavy word at the heart of Isaiah 53: his chastisement, our peace.
